pairs.l: 1  You are allowed to skip three classes per semester and it’s ok to hand in only one paper each semester.
2  There’s no need for you to rewrite the whole essay. I will read it and mark it despite your untidy handwriting.
pairs.r: A — You don’t have to do it.

pairs.l: 3  Bringing in anything that will help you with the test is strictly forbidden and you can be punished if you try cheating.
4  Security guards must search everyone before entering the stadium. So, be there at least three hours before the match.
5  We don’t have many rules here but it’s your obligation to follow them. Your instructors will make sure you don’t break any.

r1.exp: 1→F (sloboda izostaviti sate, predati jedan rad = možeš), 2→A (nije potrebno prepisivati = ne moraš), 3→C (strogo zabranjeno varanje = ne smiješ), 4→E (savjet: dođi 3 sata ranije = trebalo bi), 5→B (obveza slijediti pravila = moraš). D suvišan.

r6.exp: Noah piše: “would you like to come over to my place” → doma. Društvo će se skupiti kod njega.

r7.exp: “Easy going” = opušten (relaxed). “Kind of fun to be around” ali ne “joker” kao Bill.

r8.exp: “I’ve finally got that scholarship for the management course” → ide studirati (to study).

r9.exp: Tvrtka platila £80 smještaj, Martin platio £40 za obroke. Martin je osobno potrošio £40.

r10.exp: “I settled for a designer bracelet.” → narukvica = nakit (jewelry). Alice je napomenula pulover, Martha je razmišljala o knjizi, ali odlučila za narukvicu.

r11.exp: “where his family moved from his native Liverpool” → rodni grad = Liverpool.

r12.exp: “The band was called Boy Crew.” Kasnije su nastupali kao ‘Take This’.

r13.exp: Solo albumi: Love Thru Love (1997), Baby You’ve Got Me (1998), Never Alone (2000), Swinging (2001) = 4 albuma. Prihvatljivo: 4 / four.

r14.exp: Superlative (s bendom, prvi platinum) + Pilgrim (2003, “sold as well as Superlative”) = 2 platinum albuma. Prihvatljivo: 2 / two.

r15.exp: “first in New York, then Miami, and then Los Angeles, where he lives by the ocean” → sada živi u Los Angelesu.

pairs.l: 16  My heart just accepted her without asking my head, ___
pairs.r: B — like it was love at first sight

pairs.l: 17  Today is the most important Saturday of my life, ___
pairs.r: F — at last I will go on my first date

pairs.l: 18  I’m going to give her a flower, a red rose, ___
pairs.r: A — which I happen to know is her favourite

pairs.l: 19  The child smiled up at her, ___
pairs.r: E — wrapping little arms around her waist

pairs.l: 20  I know the man who works there, ___
pairs.r: C — so I went and asked him about her

r16.exp: 16→B (ljubav na prvi pogled), 17→F (konačno prvi spoj), 18→A (ruža — njezin omiljeni cvijet), 19→E (dijete se osmjehnulo i zagrlilo je), 20→C (znao je cvječara pa ga je pitao za nju). D suvišan.

r21.exp: “Looking for ways” = tražiti načine. Fiksna kolokacija ‘look for’ = tražiti.

r22.exp: Prošlo jednostavno (past simple) za završenu radnju: “the last time you took yourself seriously”.

r23.exp: “Gives us an opportunity” = daje nam mogućnost. Fiksna kolokacija ‘give an opportunity’.

r24.exp: Relativna zamjenica za osobe: ‘who’. “People who laugh easily”.

r25.exp: Fiksna kolokacija: “pay attention to” = obraćati pažnju na.

r27.exp: Present perfect: “Frozen has earned” = Frozen je zaradio (do sada). Prihvatljivo: has.

r28.exp: “In the first month after it came out” = u prvom mjesecu nakon izlaska. Prihvatljivo: after / when.

r29.exp: Drugi kondicionalni (unreal present): “If it were—”. Prihvatljivo: were / was.

r30.exp: Pasiv + agent: “played by Kirsten Bell” = glumički portretiran od. ‘By’ za vršitelja radnje u pasivu.

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor mora: (1) opisati najuzbudljiviji put koji je učenik doživio, (2) navesti gdje bi volio putovati u budućnosti i zašto, (3) navesti s kim bi putovao i zašto. 50–70 riječi, neformalan ton.

l1.exp: 1→D (možeš li mi pomoći), 2→B (oprosti mi), 3→E (ne govori nikome), 4→A (ne čekaj me), 5→F (dođi ranije). C suvišan.

l6.exp: Žena rezervira kazališne karte. Njezino ime je Sleighten.

l7.exp: Prijatelji organiziraju zabavu i narudit će 8 pizza.

l8.exp: Sally nije došla na zabavu jer je imala posjet (she had a visit).

l9.exp: Monica mužu govori što kupiti — mora kupiti voće (fruit).

l10.exp: Gost će promijeniti novac u hotelu (at the hotel).

l11.exp: Filip uči engleski u SAD-u već šest mjeseci.

l12.exp: Filipov najveći problem bio je življenje sam (living alone).

l13.exp: Filipovog nastavnika potaknuo je da studira računalno inženjerstvo.

l14.exp: Filip ide u Kanadu pomoći obitelji (to help his family).

l17.exp: Najnovija atrakcija za djecu je studio za ručno slikanje (Hand-Painting Studio).

l18.exp: Posjetitelji mogu birati između dva restorana.

l19.exp: Muzej ne nudi parking za posjetitelje (no parking).

l20.exp: S ulaznicon dobivate audio vodstvo (audio tours).
